title: Legarda: 17 years after Ondoy, stronger flood action needed

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Loren Legarda called for stronger flood prevention measures 17 years after Tropical Storm Ondoy, saying more communities are now experiencing floods even after short periods of heavy rain. “Seventeen years have passed since Ondoy, but instead of seeing the problem ease, there are places that did not experience flooding before but now get flooded after just a short period of heavy rain,” Legarda said in Filipino. “Repeated disruptions like this should not become a normal part of Filipino life,” she added.
